title: Seq2Pocket: Augmenting protein language models for spatially consistent binding site prediction
authors: Vít Škrhák; Lukáš Polák; Marian Novotný; David Hoksza
one_liner_zh: 该文用蛋白语言模型预测蛋白-配体结合位点，虽非TF-DNA体系，但结合位点预测与空间聚类方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作界面建模，具有一定借鉴价值。
abstract: Protein-ligand binding site prediction (LBS) is important for many areas of structural biology and molecular modeling, where, as in other tasks, protein language models (pLMs) have shown a great promise. In their application to LBS, the pLM classifies each amino acid as binding or not, but translating these predictions into three-dimensional binding pockets remains challenging; in particular, residue-centric predictions tend to produce spatially fragmented pockets. We present Seq2Pocket, a methodology for pocket-level LBS prediction that combines pLM finetuning, data enhancement, and structure-aware post-processing. First, we introduce sc-PDB enhanced , an extended training dataset that augments sc-PDB with additional small-molecule and ion-binding sites, improving coverage of non-obvious and small pockets. Second, we employ an embedding-supported smoothing classifier to refine residue-level predictions. Third, we define the Pocket Fragmentation Index and use it to select a clustering approach that preserves a consistent mapping between predictions and ground-truth pockets. We evaluate Seq2Pocket on two tasks: general binding site prediction using the LIGYSIS benchmark and cryptic binding site prediction using CryptoBench benchmark. Across both benchmarks, the proposed methodology achieves state-of-the-art performance. In particular, for general binding site prediction on the LIGYSIS benchmark, it improves distance-center-to-center recall by up to 12%, outperforming existing predictors. We believe that these findings contribute to more reliable evaluation practices in ligand binding site prediction, highlight the importance of training data curation, and provide pocket-level prediction tool that are better suited for downstream applications such as drug discovery.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-配体结合位点预测（LBS）对于结构生物学和分子建模的许多领域都很重要，在这些领域中，与其他任务一样，蛋白质语言模型（pLMs）已显示出巨大潜力。在将其应用于LBS时，pLM将每个氨基酸分类为结合或非结合，但将这些预测转化为三维结合口袋仍然具有挑战性；特别是，以残基为中心的预测往往会产生空间碎片化的口袋。我们提出了Seq2Pocket，一种结合了pLM微调、数据增强和结构感知后处理的口袋级LBS预测方法。首先，我们引入了sc-PDB enhanced，一个扩展的训练数据集，通过额外的配体和离子结合位点增强sc-PDB，提高了对非明显和小型口袋的覆盖。其次，我们采用嵌入支持的平滑分类器来细化残基级预测。第三，我们定义了口袋碎片化指数，并用它来选择一种聚类方法，以保持预测与真实口袋之间一致的映射。我们在两个任务上评估了Seq2Pocket：使用LIGYSIS基准的通用结合位点预测和使用CryptoBench基准的隐蔽结合位点预测。在两个基准上，所提出的方法均达到了最先进的性能。特别是，在LIGYSIS基准的通用结合位点预测中，它提高了距离中心到中心的召回率高达12%，优于现有预测器。我们相信，这些发现有助于在配体结合位点预测中实现更可靠的评估实践，强调了训练数据整理的重要性，并提供了更适合下游应用（如药物发现）的口袋级预测工具。
